description.zh-CN: 开源的 IDE 编码代理：在 VS Code 里改文件、跑命令、开浏览器，每一步都要你点头；支持自带 Key、Cline 云端模型或本地开源模型。
description.en: Open-source coding agent for your IDE — edits files, runs commands and browses the web in VS Code, with human approval at every step; bring your own API key, use Cline's cloud models, or point it at local open-weight models.

node.recommended: not required (runs inside VS Code's extension host)
node.supported: not required (runs inside VS Code's extension host)

runtime.note: Hard prerequisite: Visual Studio Code >= 1.101.0 (vsix engines field, measured from the shipped extension/package.json). The AiBOX route calls the `code` CLI — on macOS run VS Code's "Shell Command: Install 'code' command in PATH" once; if VS Code is missing, use the manual Marketplace route instead (zero admin). Cursor/Windsurf/VSCodium install the same extension from Open VSX (official docs).

anthropic.label: Anthropic official API (Claude)

recommendedModels.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
recommendedModels.note: Fast and cheap for small edits

anthropic.notes: Keys are stored by Cline inside VS Code's SecretStorage (encrypted, extension-owned) and are pasted in the Cline sidebar — AiBOX cannot write them to disk. configTarget points at the extension's globalStorage directory (official VS Code convention; macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Code/User/globalStorage/saoudrizwan.claude-dev); exact file layout TODO real-machine verification.

openai.label: OpenAI official API
openai.notes: Same storage model as anthropic (SecretStorage, UI entry only).

openrouter.label: OpenRouter (one key, every model)
openrouter.notes: Same storage model as anthropic (SecretStorage, UI entry only).

ollama.label: Local Ollama models (free, offline, no key)
ollama.notes: Cline can point at a local Ollama endpoint (official docs list Ollama among supported backends); no key involved. Endpoint is configured in the Cline sidebar.

upgrade.notes: Check = local `code --list-extensions --show-versions` against the tag the daily probe records; upgrade = re-run the install route with the newer VSIX (`--force` overwrites), or just click Update in the Extensions panel.

steps: VS Code → Extensions (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+X) → Cline → Uninstall, or run `code --uninstall-extension saoudrizwan.claude-dev`
Delete only the extension's own folder under ~/.vscode/extensions (name starts with saoudrizwan.claude-dev-) — other extensions live there too
API keys live in VS Code's credential store and are released when the extension is removed
uninstall.notes: Only the saoudrizwan.claude-dev-* subdirectory belongs to Cline; never delete the whole extensions directory. VSCodium uses ~/.vscode-oss. Project-side files (.clinerules, .cline/) are inside your repositories and untouched.

risk.onUninstall: Task history, checkpoints and extension settings stored under the Cline extension folder are deleted, and API keys held in VS Code's credential store are released — export/backup anything you need first. / 删除会连同 Cline 的任务历史、检查点与扩展设置一并清除，VS Code 凭据库中的 Key 也会失效——请先备份需要的内容。
